target_customer: Brands, agencies and marketplaces that pay UGC creators, contractors and AI agents
problem: Paying creators by results across countries requires tax forms, identity checks and compliance work that payroll and AP tools handle poorly.
business_model: Payouts platform and API acting as merchant of record; fee model unclear (a blog post cites a 5 percent creator side fee, the marketplace page says per payout)
product_category: Performance based payroll and creator payouts API

founders.name: Lotanna Ezeike
previous_startups: Previous company not named, 2x VC backed founder per YC page
founders.background_notes: Product lead at Barclays for digital payments.

founders.name: James Heaney
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. School not named.

competitors.name: Trolley
competitors.what: Creator and affiliate payouts API with tax forms
competitors.traction_then: named as strongest creator focused alternative in 2026 roundups

competitors.name: Tipalti
competitors.what: AP automation with creator payouts API

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments, tax reporting and compliance across 190 plus countries rely on partners but need careful integration.

defensibility.rationale: Merchant of record and compliance work is a barrier, but Trolley, Tipalti and Stripe style infrastructure can add pay by email features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A March 2026 profile flags that a payments giant could build this natively; no action found.

market_need_then: Company reports 380K dollars paid to creators in 30 days, up 120 percent month over month, and 790 plus creators paid (YC launch post, self reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses usegrade.com, a use prefix domain; legal entity is Creator Check Technology, Inc.

identity.visual_style: Clean minimal layout with large headlines

branding.community_and_virality: A March 2026 HUGE Magazine profile covered the company.

brand_strength.rationale: Short clear word but very generic, so search is crowded with unrelated grading products, and the legal entity name differs.

pivots.from: Creator payouts for mobile app UGC campaigns
pivots.to: API for performance based payroll including AI agents and contractors
pivots.why: Launch post says paying creators for views exposed the lack of a performance pay payroll tool; the date is the YC launch period and is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Grade is active in the Winter 2026 batch with two founders who previously ran mobile app creator campaigns and report fast payout growth. Funding is not public and the space has established payout and AP vendors that could copy its pay by email approach.
notes: No funding found for Grade. The pivot is inferred from the launch post narrative and the date is approximate, listed with that caveat. Founder education not found. The Crunchbase entry for Creator Check was not confirmed to be the same company.
